changes.title: Add scoped chunk recovery and previews

title: Improve ReactAgent recovery and verification
summary:
Improved ReactAgent’s reliability when inspecting tool results and validating mutations.

- Added run-scoped recovery and concise previews for chunked results.
- Added evidence audits and corrective-call guidance.
- Strengthened verification of exact text, dates, and persisted time zones.
- Updated focused agent and prompt tests; tests were not run per instruction.
